title.zh: 大量招募與 RPO｜新廠開線、據點擴張與招募流程外包｜HRK365
title.en: Volume Hiring & RPO in Taiwan | New Sites, Expansion and Embedded Recruitment | HRK365

desc.zh: HRK365 大量招募與 RPO：新廠開線、據點擴張與季節性進人的批次招募，或整段招募流程外包並內嵌你的 HR 團隊。
desc.en: HRK365 volume hiring and RPO: batch recruitment for new plants, site expansion and seasonal intakes — or an embedded team taking over your hiring process end to end.

sub.zh: 同時要補二十個人，跟補一個人是完全不同的工程。前者要的是流程、批次與現場執行力，不是更多顧問。
sub.en: Filling twenty seats at once is a different engineering problem from filling one. It calls for process, batching and on-the-ground execution — not simply more consultants.

body.zh: 針對單一批次需求執行，有明確的人數目標與完成期限。
body.en: A single batch with a defined headcount target and completion date.

bullets.zh: 新廠開線、產線擴編或季節性進人
bullets.en: New plants, line expansions or seasonal intakes

bullets.zh: 統一的職缺說明、篩選標準與面談腳本
bullets.en: One standardised brief, screening bar and interview script

bullets.zh: 集體面談日與現場作業安排
每週回報進度、到缺率與流失原因
bullets.en: Weekly reporting on progress, fill rate and drop-off reasons

body.zh: 長期承接你整段或部分招募流程，等同你的外部招募團隊。
body.en: A longer engagement taking over all or part of your hiring process, working as your external recruitment team.

bullets.zh: 從職缺開立、履歷篩選到面試安排全段承接
bullets.en: From requisition and CV screening through to interview scheduling

bullets.zh: 使用你的雇主品牌與招募系統作業
bullets.en: Working under your employer brand and inside your ATS

bullets.zh: 定期提供招募數據與流程改善建議
bullets.en: Regular hiring metrics and process improvement recommendations

bullets.zh: 可依人數規模與期間彈性調整投入
bullets.en: Resourcing flexes with volume and duration

title.zh: 大量招募的成敗在到職率，不在面試人數
title.en: Volume hiring is won on show-up rate, not interview count

body.zh:
很多大量招募案的報表很好看——邀約多少人、面試多少人——但真正決定成敗的只有兩個數字：實際到職人數，以及三個月後還在的人數。

面試爽約、錄取後不報到、報到一週就離職，這些流失發生在哪個環節、原因是什麼，必須追蹤到底才改得動。我們的專案回報以到職與留任為核心指標，而不是活動量。
body.en:
Volume hiring reports often look busy — how many invited, how many interviewed — but only two numbers decide the outcome: how many actually started, and how many are still there after three months.

No-shows, accepted offers that never begin, hires who leave in week one — where those losses happen and why has to be tracked before anything can be fixed. Our reporting is built around starts and retention, not activity volume.

items.zh: 錄取到實際報到的轉換率
到職後 30／90 天的留任率
各招募管道的成本與品質比較
items.en: Cost and quality by sourcing channel

items.zh: 流失原因分類（薪資、班別、通勤、其他機會）
items.en: Drop-off reasons — pay, shift, commute, competing offers

q.zh: 多少人以上才算大量招募？
q.en: How many roles make it a volume project?

a.zh: 沒有硬性門檻。判斷標準是「同質職缺是否多到值得用批次流程處理」——同一種職務同時要補十人以上，通常用專案制比逐一委任更有效率也更便宜。
a.en: There is no fixed threshold. The test is whether there are enough similar roles to justify a batch process: ten or more of the same job at once is usually cheaper and faster as a project than as individual assignments.

q.zh: RPO 期間我們自己的 HR 要做什麼？
q.en: What does our own HR do during an RPO?

a.zh: 你的 HR 保留決策權與雇主品牌的主導權，我們承接執行。實務上最有效的分工是：你決定用人標準與 offer 條件，我們負責把流程跑順並提供數據。
a.en: Your HR keeps the decisions and ownership of the employer brand; we take the execution. The split that works best in practice: you set the hiring bar and offer terms, we run the process and supply the data.

q.en: Can you run this at an overseas site?

a.zh: 可以。台灣客戶在越南、馬來西亞設廠時的當地招募，我們可透過新加坡總部的區域資源支援，並提供當地的雇用形式與薪資結構建議。
a.en: Yes. For Taiwanese clients standing up plants in Vietnam or Malaysia, we support local hiring through our Singapore parent's regional resources, and advise on local employment models and pay structures.

title.en: The earlier we plan, the less it costs

body.zh: 在確定要開線之前就可以先談人力規劃。市場上有沒有這麼多人、要花多久、大概多少成本，我們先給你一個現實的評估。
body.en: Workforce planning can start before the line is even confirmed. Whether the market has that many people, how long it takes and roughly what it costs — we will give you a realistic read first.
